corpus.title: Orion releases reasoning model weights
corpus.summary: Orion released downloadable weights for a reasoning model. The release supports long-form problem solving.

corpus.title: Solis adds image reasoning to its model
corpus.summary: Solis released a new reasoning model with image understanding. Model weights are available for download.

corpus.title: Permit gateway controls agent tool permissions
corpus.summary: Permit introduced an AI gateway enforcing per-agent tool and model access policies. Approval flows and audit records support technical governance.

corpus.title: AgentGate adds approval and audit policies
corpus.summary: AgentGate added AI gateway approval workflows and tool access controls. Administrators can audit the decisions without changing legal requirements.

corpus.title: Meter allocates AI spending to project budgets
corpus.summary: Meter introduced project-level cost allocation and budget alerts for AI usage. Teams can track model spending and attribute costs.

corpus.title: SpendLens reports inference costs by team
corpus.summary: SpendLens added AI inference cost reports and team budget controls. The feature supports financial allocation and spending optimization.

corpus.title: Pine SDK supports asynchronous streaming
corpus.summary: Pine released an SDK for asynchronous API calls and streamed model responses. Developers can use the new client in application code.

corpus.title: Nova client library adds async response streams
corpus.summary: Nova added asynchronous request handling and response streaming to its developer SDK. Synchronous integrations remain supported.

corpus.title: Quartz improves GPU cluster interconnect
corpus.summary: Quartz upgraded the network linking GPU servers in its AI training cluster. The hardware change reduces accelerator communication latency.

corpus.title: Copper accelerates communication between GPU servers
corpus.summary: Copper added a faster GPU server network for distributed model training. The deployment focuses on accelerator interconnect bandwidth.

corpus.title: Patch closes document prompt injection vulnerability
corpus.summary: Maintainers patched a prompt-injection flaw in a document-reading assistant. Untrusted documents can no longer change tool authorization through that vulnerability.

corpus.title: Agent credential disclosure bug receives a fix
corpus.summary: A security advisory describes a patched credential-leak vulnerability in an AI agent. The fix prevents hostile source instructions from exposing credentials.

corpus.title: Regulator adopts binding AI disclosure rule
corpus.summary: A regulator adopted a binding legal rule requiring AI training-data disclosures. Providers must comply with the new regulation.

corpus.title: Authority enforces AI transparency law
corpus.summary: A regulatory authority imposed a fine for violations of binding AI disclosure law. The action concerns legal enforcement rather than software access policies.

corpus.title: Aurora raises AI venture funding
corpus.summary: Aurora announced a venture investment round for its AI business. The funding supports hiring and commercial expansion.

corpus.title: Horizon receives investment for its AI company
corpus.summary: Horizon secured venture funding to grow its AI business. The announcement covers investment rather than model or product features.

corpus.title: Voyager assistant prepares travel itineraries
corpus.summary: Voyager launched an AI assistant application that plans trips and suggests itineraries. Users approve the travel plan before booking.

corpus.title: Beacon assistant turns meetings into tasks
corpus.summary: Beacon introduced an AI assistant for organizing meeting notes into proposed tasks. Users approve tasks before adding them to a work list.

corpus.title: Atlas benchmark studies vector retrieval recall
corpus.summary: Researchers published a benchmark of embedding-based document retrieval. The study compares vector search recall and filtering behavior.

corpus.title: Study measures filtered semantic search quality
corpus.summary: A research study evaluates semantic retrieval with metadata filters. It reports recall measurements for vector document search.

corpus.title: LakeCloud expands managed inference availability
corpus.summary: LakeCloud made its managed AI inference service available in another region. The announcement focuses on provider service availability.

corpus.title: RiverAI offers a managed embedding API
corpus.summary: RiverAI launched a managed embedding API for developers. The provider operates the model service rather than supplying an application or database.
